nextFocus: P4 stale-worker successor safety proof and mutation-side fencing

focus: P4 stale-worker successor safety proof and mutation-side fencing

Renew, release, checkpoint, completion, failure, retry, salvage, effect, and terminal mutations must never resolve caller ownership from node alone

Graphene read-set and claim admission can inform read-only lanes, but write-wave admission additionally requires a fresh authorized conflict-free plan and mutation-side fences

ruledOut.approach: Authorize parallel writes from claimability or wave admission alone
